# Aqua UI

> The original Aqua desktop (2001, build 4K78) rebuilt in pure CSS — every gradient transcribed
> from the real widget bitmaps, not eyeballed. One self-contained stylesheet
> (`aqua.css`), an optional TypeScript custom-element layer
> (`@aqua-ui/web-components`, tags prefixed `aqua-`, stylesheet bundled), and React
> bindings (`@aqua-ui/react`, components prefixed `Aqua`).

Ground rules for generated code: wrap Aqua content in a `class="aqua"`
ancestor; never edit `aqua.css` (generated — source is
the original widget artwork, outside this repo); prefer native elements with classes over styled divs;
never stretch a control vertically (widget heights are native to the
artwork); the embedded Apple artwork is not redistributable.

## Docs

- [components.html](components.html): the human docs — every control live
  (HTML, needs a browser)
